## Experiments

* **search-binary-collation** – Search on a persisted computed column UPPER(Title + ' ' + OrganizationName) with a binary collation, covered by its own narrow index: reads 4,900, CPU 38 ms, elapsed 40.58 ms. Plan: Index Seek; Sort → Clustered Index Scan
* **deep-page-keyset** – The same deep page (sorted by title) with keyset paging: continue after the last row of the previous page instead of skipping 49,900 rows, with an index on (Title, Id): reads 333, CPU 0 ms, elapsed 0.0 ms. Plan: Table Scan; Index Seek → Clustered Index Seek
